method: Recompute all 192 published latest-versus-prior month percentage changes within the same release and compare stored values
For each pair of consecutive releases, identify the prior release latest observation month in the next release as published; compare exact two published levels only when both refer to that month
Separate same-base revisions from base-year switches; report every switch without treating absolute level ratios as a tradable signal
Do not use latest FRED backfill, model labels, SOXX returns, Stage1 accounts or feature selection
decision_boundary: Numerical internal consistency and observed revisions only. Even perfect arithmetic does not certify economic definition continuity, historical first receipt, or predictive information.
